_comment: Where one run of app-profile lands. It runs from the APP's repo and writes only into the hub — the single most common cross-repo shape in this factory, and the one where a session sees a clean `git status` while the work sits uncommitted somewhere it is not standing.
operates_from: the app's repo — that is where the source it reads lives

places.note: The profile and its owner-facing translation are one change and one commit: the translation is a derived mirror, and committing the English without it leaves the two saying different things with nothing to notice.

_order_why: One place, and it is never the place the session is standing in. That is the whole reason this file exists.
